summary: The color-target bound is correct: positive-load edges have positive fiber masses, AM-GM gives the stated lower bound on each theta_e, and the reservoir/load bounds give the claimed per-edge estimate. For a fixed midpoint, unordered distinct edges are pairwise endpoint-disjoint, so their endpoint masses total at most A_xi, yielding kappa_{xi,m} at most 1/4. Summing over the 2^n parity classes gives the global bound, and for n at most 2 this forces every multiplier to equal one and hence zero congestion charge and zero fresh load under the accepted convention. Empty, bad, zero-mass, and equality cases are handled correctly.
